scope: Nine scoped rules, not five complete government profiles or a national procedural code. No production loader/clock execution is claimed.

ny.locator: New York Constitution, Article III, section 14

tx.locator: 89th Legislature House adopted rules, Rule 8 sections 14–15, January 23, 2025 journal

rules.appliesWhen: regular-session bill other than the budget bill
remaining: Apply the represented session and bill classification; this is not a three-day delay between all stages.
Distinct days are not a compulsory elapsed gap of three days after each reading.

separate prior house roll-call waiver recorded in journal

remaining: Track the actual version; an emergency event alone is not a waiver. Effective-date and urgency-statute rules are separate.

remaining: The quoted constitutional unit requires a verified calendar interpretation; do not silently translate it to 72 hours.

remaining: Verify recipient session/version; this does not establish a separate Senate rules profile.

rules.appliesWhen: municipal body to which statutory procedure applies
remaining: Confirm charter-specific applicability. This is not the rule of every Ohio charter municipality by assertion.

integration: Keep eligibility, actual scheduling, member decision, enactment and operative date separate. All applicable constraints combine; satisfying one is not satisfying all.
Use each chamber/body calendar and the actual bill revision, session and recorded waivers. Recess is not a new reading and idle days are not automatic hearings.
Legal permission never compels action. Agenda, notice, capacity and actual decisions determine the next feasible step through the existing common clock.
An unknown factual detail is explicit; do not turn this partial research into a blanket all-state hold. Label allowed game scheduling assumptions without calling them sourced law.
Use existing sourced veto thresholds and real eligible members. A coin flip is neither the vote nor the reason an override attempt begins.
Controlled-player ballots require an explicit choice or valid already-selected standing instruction in its supported scope; pending actions and sponsorship are not consent.
